title.narrative: THIS THREE-YEAR PROJECT AIMS TO MAINTAIN AND ENHANCE THE PROTECTION OF WILD ASIAN ELEPHANTS IN THE RAKHINE YOMA ELEPHANT RANGE (RYER) IN MYANMAR THROUGH CONTINUED ENGAGEMENT WITH ELEPHANT PROTECTION U

description.narrative: This three-year project aims to maintain and enhance the protection of wild Asian elephants in the Rakhine Yoma Elephant Range (RYER) in Myanmar through continued engagement with Elephant Protection Units (EPU), provision of training and support, and patrol gear to improve patrol performance and morale. Project activities include: 1) increase the operational effectiveness of existing EPUs and expand coverage by hiring additional captive Myanma Timber Enterprise (MTE) elephants; 2) upgrade ranger substations and provisions of boats; 3) increase effectiveness of patrols through adaptive SMART patrol methodology; 4) identify elephant distribution and hotspots; and 5) regular analysis of satellite imagery to monitor and respond to forest encroachment and shifting cultivation within RYER. This project will maintain and enhance the protection of wild elephants and other wildlife of the RYER through the use of SMART-managed patrolling and development of staff capacity to allow government and local staff to carry out their duties.
